verdict.rationale: A government business-filing service could plausibly offer an official CLI, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only a web portal (bizfile Online), mail or in-person submission, and bulk data files, with no mention of any CLI. Probes also found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and the portal sits behind bot management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
